in_marathi.name: Sahin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sahin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sahin is a Hindu name that means warrior or lion. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sa-hin' which translates to 'with-army' or 'with-lions'. This name is often given to boys who are expected to show courage, strength, and protection to those around them.
